# Forbes

> > Forbes is a global media company providing business news, financial information, and brand partnership opportunities through digital advertising and recognition programs.

Forbes operates a self-service advertising platform (Forbes Ad Manager) for brands to reach targeted audiences, alongside a recognition products store for companies to showcase their Forbes accolades and awards.

## Key Topics

- Forbes Ad Manager
- Digital Advertising
- Self-Service Platform
- Campaign Management
- Audience Targeting
- Brand Advertising
- Company Recognition
- Professional Awards
- Business Accolades
- Forbes Awards

## Advertising & Marketing Platforms

- [Forbes Ad Manager](https://admanager.forbes.com/): Self-service advertising platform for brand partners and audience targeting

## Optional

- [Forbes Accolade Store](https://accoladesproducts.forbes.com/): Store for purchasing Forbes awards and company recognition products
